inputs.text: [excited] Uh… PAT… oh… SOR… us. [curious] In Greek, "apato" means trickery, an illusion.
[happily] Yep — [amazed] its bones fooled scientists for a really long time, [calm] way back when. It lived in North America, [pauses] a hundred fifty million years ago.
[confident] For years, people thought it was a different dinosaur, [serious] called Brontosaurus. [amazed] Turns out, it's a very close cousin — [warmly] not quite the same animal.
